rows.name: Trio: one of our three styles wins
rows.target: In a 6-player game with our greedy, balanced and aggressive civs and 3 CP civs, one of ours wins ≥ 90% of full games (the user's aim: every game)
rows.detail: Built. Quick look (4 games to T150): one of ours on top in 3 (75%); our three held 51.7-57.6% of the strength in every game; greedy never on top. Our aggressor never attacked in those games (since fixed). The real 20-game run waits for working attacks, with greedy wide/tall.

rows.name: Strength against CP
rows.target: ≥ 60% strength share against CP's AI (a milestone; strength is now the guard and quick test for each change)
rows.detail: 50.4% (C8, the 12 flags that passed, 6 pairs on PC 2). Economy and diplomacy fixes moved it only about half a point by T150; the big lever left is war, cities changing hands.

rows.name: Attack: an aggressor takes cities
rows.target: Against greedy civs (few units, no walls) several cities by T150; against balanced civs at most 1 per war
rows.detail: Progress tonight: with WarGold (e4d5785) the aggressor declared war in 10 of 11 games where it runs the fixes (it used to sit broke, its cities building workers). 1 capture in those 11 (Zulus took Shanghai). The blocker now: tactics won't attack a city in an enemy-held area. War's SiegeDominated fix is in the siege build 7bb7885, testing next.

rows.name: Matchup triangle
rows.target: Greedy beats balanced, aggressive beats greedy, balanced beats aggressive; no style wins overall
rows.detail: The three styles are coded (Personality). The matchup test waits until attacks reliably take cities.

rows.name: Coalition against a runaway
rows.target: 2+ civs at war with the aggressor within 20 turns of its first conquest
rows.detail: One case so far: the Huns' first capture came about T120, and 4 civs were at war with them by T140.

rows.name: A lively world, no deal spam
rows.detail: About 3 per civ per 10 turns, for B and C8 alike (12 C8 games; each deal counts once per side), so above the band. Diplomacy hasn't worked on deal frequency yet.

rows.name: Banned behaviours
rows.target: 0 per game (workers stolen in peace, wonder chops)
rows.detail: Wonder chops about 1 per game in both B and C8 (12 C8 games); 1 stolen worker by B, 0 by C8. Not worked on yet.

rows.name: AI turn speed
rows.detail: C8 games average 5.6 s per AI turn. In split games both groups share one turn, so this needs an all-C run against an all-B run; not run yet.

rows.name: Now
rows.detail: The attack starts now: with WarGold (build e4d5785) the aggressor declared war in all 4 games where it has the fixes (6 wars). Before, its cities built workers instead of an army and it went broke at peace. Still 0 captures: armies time out on the march, then won't attack a city in an enemy-held area. War is on it.
